programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas

programme.desc: 'S40/E11 - All Over Flavor'. Guy Fieri gets a taste of barbecue beef banh mi in Boston, lamb meatball sub and octopus in Montana and jerk chicken in Minneapolis.

programme.desc: 'S14/E7 - I'm Kind Of A Big Dill'. The chefs make hash browns on a pan shaped like Alton Brown's face, cook Cubanos on baseball bats, and make tiramisu while holding tiny hands.

programme.title: Alex Vs America

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S55/E2 - Julia Child's Kitchen: Part 1'. Creativity blossoms as four Julia Child fans compete with baskets inspired by Julia's recipes for a chance to win a dream trip to France!

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S51/E8 - Greater Gator'. The chefs get alligator in the first basket and race to see who can make it most tender and flavourful. Later, missteps in the final round result in errors.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E11 - Jerusalem'. From savoury classics like shawarma, falafel, kubbeh and hummus to tempting pastries like halva and bureka, Jerusalem's edible icons are steeped in history.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E12 - Amman'. Andrew samples some of the dishes of Amman, Jordan, such as multi-tiered towers of goat and veggies, sumac-coated chicken with onions and lamb cooked in creamy yogurt sauce.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E13 - Mumbai'. Andrew explores edible icons of Mumbai, including deep-fried fish and prawns, saucy goat over rice and vegetarian dishes from puffed rice salad to spicy potato mashups.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E14 - Hyderabad'. Andrew Zimmern explores the aromatic treasures of Hyderabad. He samples savoury potato pastries, silver-garnished syrupy fried bread and hearty meals of meat and rice.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E15 - Panama City'. Andrew Zimmern uncovers Panama City's classic tastes inspired by its blended cultures. They include fried whole fish and plantains and citric ceviche and yucca fritters.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E16 - Trinidad And Tobago'. Andrew samples the culinary mashups of Trinidad and Tobago including curried crab with dumplings, crispy fried shark sandwiches, and soft flatbreads.

programme.title: Skree Dit Uit!

programme.title: Entertainment Set

programme.title: Yosef

programme.title: Maanligsprokie

programme.title: Een Wit Leuen

programme.title: Lente Na Die Storm

programme.title: Fenix

programme.title: Twist of Fate
